lines.text: What are you coming in with today?
I'm coming in with a sore neck after sleeping funny on Saturday.
Any numbness or pins and needles down the arms?
Nope, I have not had any numbness at all.
Sorry, I'll just grab the phone. Hello, Wattle Street Physio.
Yep, Thursday at ten is fine. No worries, see you then, bye.
Sorry about that. Let me have a look at how far you can turn your head.
Turning to the left is the worst bit.
It's pretty tight on the left side, so I'll do some massage there today.
I'll send you some exercises for the neck as well.
